stick_the_langlands_program.question: The Langlands program
references: R. P. Langlands, letter to A. Weil (1967)
A. Wiles, Modular elliptic curves and Fermat's Last Theorem, Ann. Math. 141 (1995) 443
C. Breuil, B. Conrad, F. Diamond, R. Taylor, J. AMS 14 (2001) 843 (modularity for all E/Q)
L. Lafforgue, Invent. Math. 147 (2002) 1 (Langlands for GL(n) over function fields)
stick_the_langlands_program.statement: Is there a grand unification of mathematics — a precise correspondence between Galois representations (number theory) and automorphic forms (harmonic analysis), with their L-functions equal? The full program is a web of conjectures, largely OPEN over number fields; specific cases are proven. The open question is the general correspondence, not the proven pillars.

ticks.claim: [modularity - the curve side meets the form side, p=2] For the elliptic curve 11a1 (y^2 + y = x^3 - x^2 - 10x - 20), counting points over F_2 gives #E(F_2) = 5, so the trace of Frobenius is a_2 = (2+1) - 5 = -2 (sealed). The SAME number -2 is the q^2 coefficient of the weight-2 level-11 newform eta(z)^2 eta(11z)^2. A point-count on a cubic and a coefficient of a modular form - two unrelated computations - agree: this is the degree-2 Langlands reciprocity (modularity).

[modularity, p=3] Over F_3, #E(F_3) = 5 for the same curve, so a_3 = (3+1) - 5 = -1 (sealed) - exactly the q^3 coefficient of the same newform. The agreement is not a coincidence to be checked prime by prime forever; modularity (Taniyama-Shimura-Weil) says it holds for ALL p, proven for every elliptic curve over Q (Wiles; Breuil-Conrad-Diamond-Taylor 2001).

[the proven pillars] Modularity IS the GL(2) case of Langlands reciprocity over Q - and the road by which Fermat's Last Theorem was proven (Wiles 1995). The abelian GL(1) case is class field theory, whose automorphic L-functions are the Riemann zeta and Dirichlet L-functions (ties stick_riemann_hypothesis). The full correspondence over FUNCTION fields is proven (Drinfeld; L. Lafforgue, Fields Medal 2002). These are the sealed/proven marks on the stick.

[the open vision] The general program - GL(n) over number fields, the automorphy of arbitrary Galois representations, the geometric Langlands correspondence - remains a web of conjectures: the grand unification of number theory, representation theory and harmonic analysis. Like the four forces under alpha, it is a unity the proven cases POINT AT without completing. Seal the instances (a_p), attribute the conjecture, keep it open - narrowing is evidence, never proof.
